## What's changed

- Automatically upscale lower-resolution video to the detected display resolution for Apple TV and Android/Google TV players.
- Added Spline36 scaling for these server-side upscales while preserving the source aspect ratio.
- Keep audio and video on one freshly encoded timeline during TV upscaling to preserve playback synchronization.
- Leave Steam and retro-player playback behavior unchanged.

No player app update is required for this server-side playback improvement.
